title: Shortener.dev - URL shortener with click analytics
excerpt: Free URL shortener to create short links on your own domain, with click analytics, UTM builder, expiration, passwords, device and geo targeting, and an API.
content_html:
Shorten any link
Share it anywhere
See every click

Short links on your own domain with click analytics, UTM parameters, expiration, passwords, and device and geo targeting.

Free for 10 links with click analytics, no card required.

Short links

Every option, on every link

Pick the back-half, add UTM parameters, write the social preview, set a password or an expiry date. All link options are on every plan, including free.

  1. 01Your own back-half and domain
  2. 02UTM builder and social preview card
  3. 03Expiration, password, device and geo rules

Analytics

Know who clicked, and from where

Every click is counted with its country, city, referrer, browser, operating system and device, so you can see which post, email or poster is working.

  1. 01Clicks by day, country and city
  2. 02Referrer, browser, OS and device
  3. 03Raw click reports on paid plans

Targeting

One link, the right destination

Send iPhone users to the App Store, Android users to Google Play and visitors from each country to their own page, all from the same short link.

  1. 01iOS and Android app links
  2. 02Per-country destinations
  3. 03Change the destination any time

Developers

Shorten from your code

A REST API for everything in the dashboard: links, domains, projects, analytics and click reports. Create an API key and send one request.

  • 01Create, update and delete links
  • 02Read analytics and click reports
  • 03OpenAPI spec for any language
OpenAPI spec

terminal

$ curl -X POST https://api.shortener.dev/v1/links \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SHORTENER_API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"url": "https://acme.com/spring",
         "key": "spring",
         "params": {"utm_source": "email"}}'

{
  "key": "spring",
  "short_url": "https://srt1.link/spring",
  "url": "https://acme.com/spring",
  "is_enabled": true
}

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What is a URL shortener?

A URL shortener turns a long web address into a short link, like srt1.link/spring, that redirects to the original page. Short links are easier to share and let you count the clicks.

Is Shortener.dev free?

Yes. The free plan includes 10 short links with click analytics, and you can sign in and shorten a link right from the form on this page. Paid plans start at $29 a month.

Can I change where a short link points after I share it?

Yes. Edit the destination at any time from the dashboard or the API, and the same short link sends visitors to the new page.

Can I use my own domain?

Yes. Paid plans include custom domains, so your links can look like go.yourbrand.com/offer.

What does the click analytics include?

Clicks over time with country, city, referrer, browser, operating system and device, plus raw click reports on paid plans.

How do you stop abuse?

Destinations are checked against blocklists and safe browsing services before a link is created, and anyone can report a suspicious short link.
